about: One entry per acceptance check for Bench. Change only `passes`, and only for the one feature you finished. See ralph/bench/PROMPT.md.

features.description: Each use case has exactly one home: src/smeltery/bench/use_cases/. The diverged copy in bench/application/ is gone.
steps: Diff application/ against use_cases/; port any behaviour that exists only in application/ into use_cases/.
Delete src/smeltery/bench/application/ and fix every import.
Run the bench gate.

features.description: SubprocessTaskQueue never reports an exit-0 task as failed, even transiently, and the exit code is present when the status first becomes terminal.
steps: Add test_a_successful_task_is_never_observed_as_failed: submit `bash -c 'echo hi'`, call status() in a tight loop recording every value until terminal; assert 'failed' never appears and the final value is 'succeeded'.
Add test_returncode_is_set_when_status_first_turns_terminal: for `bash -c 'exit 3'`, at the first poll where status() is terminal, get(id).returncode == 3.
Data source: the real exit status of the bash process.
Fix the adapter so status and returncode are written together by whichever code path observes the exit.
Mutation: make _refresh mark a dead pid 'failed' without its exit code; confirm both new tests fail; revert.
test_a_submitted_task_runs_and_reports_succeeded and test_a_failing_command_reports_failed_with_its_code pass 10 runs in a row (`for i in $(seq 10); do ...; done`).

features.description: Unknown task ids behave the same in both queue adapters: get -> None, tail_log -> KeyError, cancel -> KeyError.
steps: Extend test_an_unknown_task_id_is_handled_consistently to assert cancel('ghost') raises KeyError.
Make both adapters satisfy it.

features.description: TemporalTaskQueue has the typed constructor from task-queue.md, and its contract run is skipped with a reason when no server answers.
steps: Replace `__init__(self, *a, **kw)` with the exact signature in task-queue.md requirement 7.
Register TemporalTaskQueue in the contract; skip (pytest.skip with the connection error) when 127.0.0.1:7233 does not answer.
uvx ty@0.0.96 check reports nothing for adapters/task_queue.py.

features.description: The atom-order anchor compares the provisional order with the order read from the run's pose SDF files, and is proven live by mutation.
steps: Delete pose_symbols from src/smeltery/bench/provisional.py if it derives order from SMILES; production code does not need it.

Rewrite test_provisional_order_equals_the_runs_pose_order: for each candidate, parse smeltery.gui.results.pose_sdf(run, name) with RDKit (removeHs=False) and compare its atom symbols to provisional_pose(smiles)[0].
Data source: OUT/poses/<candidate>.sdf through pose_sdf. Not the SMILES.
Mutation 1: in a copy of the fixture, swap two differently-element atoms in one pose SDF (and update the record's sha256 for that file); confirm the test fails; revert.
Mutation 2: delete OUT/poses/; confirm the test errors or fails, never passes; revert.

features.description: The append-only ProjectStore test asserts the specific exception an edit raises, not bare Exception.
features.verify: .venv/bin/python -m ruff check tests/bench --select B017 && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:randomly tests/bench/contracts/test_project_store.py
steps: Replace pytest.raises(Exception) in test_an_entry_is_append_only with the adapter's specific exception type.
If the adapter has no edit method, assert instead that no public method name starts with edit or update.

features.description: The app keeps comment and project stores under <root>/.smeltery/bench/, never in the current directory.
steps: Add test_local_stores_live_under_the_runs_root: build the app from smeltery.bench.app's composition root with root=tmp_path, cwd elsewhere; assert both sqlite files are under tmp_path/.smeltery/bench/ and none was created in the cwd.
Change app.py's defaults accordingly.
Delete the stray /home/matt/qc/smeltery/.bench_comments.sqlite and .bench_projects.sqlite (artefacts of the old default).

features.description: .gitignore covers .ralph/, .opencode/ and .smeltery/.
features.verify: git check-ignore -q .ralph && git check-ignore -q .opencode && git check-ignore -q .smeltery
steps: Append the three entries to .gitignore.

features.description: docs/bench.md says only true things about layering and the task queue.
features.verify: rg -q 'tasks.py' docs/bench.md && rg -qi 'at most once' docs/bench.md
steps: Correct the layering paragraph: temporalio also appears in src/smeltery/tasks.py, the one named exception.
State that a task runs at most once and a dead worker's task is reported failed, not retried.

features.description: The bench extra sits under its own comment, and the desktop extra is back under its comment.
steps: Move `bench = [...]` so that the `smeltery gui OUT --desktop` comment is directly above `desktop = [...]`.
Give `bench` its own comment line above it naming smeltery.bench as the importer.

features.description: ruff check and ruff format --check are clean across src and tests.
features.verify: .venv/bin/python -m ruff check src tests && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check src tests
steps: Run `ruff check --fix` and `ruff format` on the bench files, then fix the remainder by hand.
Do not add noqa to silence a real finding.

steps: Confirm each of requirements 1-4 has a test; add any missing (decisions must not import project).
Mutation: add `import sqlite3` to a file in use_cases/; confirm a test fails; revert.

features.description: verdict_of maps every record to exactly one state, per verdict.md.
steps: Confirm tests cover RESOLVED, UNRANKED, INCOMPLETE, the precedence of INCOMPLETE, and an empty results block.
Confirm verdict_of does not call gui.results.load_run (rg in src/smeltery/bench/verdict.py).
Mutation: make an unranked cut return its first group as winner; confirm a test fails; revert.

features.description: Study.plan_cells returns one row per (condition, step), sharing plan()'s key derivation.
steps: Confirm the counts test compares against Study.plan(), not against a recount inside the test.
Mutation: change plan_cells' key derivation (e.g. drop upstream keys); confirm a test fails; revert.

features.description: --only-candidate measures only the named candidate; the parent is measured once, in its own partial.
steps: Create tests/test_run_split.py using a fixture config on the cheapest tier.
test_only_candidate_writes_a_partial_and_no_cut: partial-<name>.json exists and has no results.cut; no run-*.json is left.
test_an_analogue_partial_does_not_remeasure_the_parent: count tier calls (monkeypatch the measure function); an analogue invocation measures exactly one candidate.
Data source: the partial JSON files on disk and the counted measure calls.

features.description: --combine produces the same record as a single-process run, carrying every per-pose quantity.
steps: test_split_then_combine_gives_the_same_record_as_one_process: compare the two run-*.json files field by field, excluding only timing fields named in the test.
test_combine_carries_every_per_pose_quantity: with a gate that records E_mmff, the combined record has it.
test_combine_without_every_partial_refuses_naming_the_missing_ones: stderr names each missing candidate; exit code 2.
test_an_unknown_candidate_name_is_a_config_error_with_a_message.
Run the cli.py row of the AGENTS.md table.

features.description: Resident memory per process stays roughly flat across a 10-candidate split run.
steps: Run a 10-candidate config split per candidate, recording peak RSS of each process with /usr/bin/time -v.
Write the 11 numbers to NOTES.md. If they climb by more than 25% from first to last, this feature does not pass.

features.description: After the core changes (which touch cli.py), the full suite is no worse than baseline.
steps: Run the full suite once.
Record the counts in NOTES.md.

features.description: create_app takes its ports as keyword arguments; use cases import no web framework.
steps: Confirm create_app's signature matches app-shell.md requirement 1.
Add test_no_use_case_imports_a_web_framework reading the files in use_cases/.
Mutation: import fastapi in one use case; confirm the test fails; revert.

features.description: A failing task queue gives 503 with a reason in under 2 s while /api/runs answers 200.
steps: Confirm both existing tests assert the JSON error field and the 2 s bound.
Mutation: let /api/runs call task_queue.list(); confirm a test fails; revert.

features.description: GET /api/runs/{idx}/verdict returns the Verdict for RESOLVED, UNRANKED and INCOMPLETE records.
steps: Cover all three states over HTTP, using make_run_dir, make_run_dir(unranked=True), and a record with results.cut deleted.

features.description: No endpoint takes the acting user from the request body.
steps: Add test_a_user_field_in_the_request_is_ignored for every POST route that records an author or user.

features.description: `smeltery bench [ROOT] [--port N] [--open]` starts the app; adapters are wired only there.

Start it on a free port in the background, curl /healthz for 200, kill it by PID.
Run the cli.py row of the AGENTS.md table.

test_no_page_references_an_external_origin scans every served HTML and template.
test_static_files_are_served: GET /static/app.css is 200.

features.description: Colour tokens and dark mode match frontend.md; data colours come from smeltery.gui.scenes.
steps: test_the_data_colours_match_the_scene_builder imports scenes.CHARGE_POSITIVE, CHARGE_NEGATIVE, CANDIDATE_CARBON and finds them in app.css.
test_dark_mode_is_defined_for_every_colour_token.
test_numeric_cells_use_tabular_figures: app.css sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.
test_reduced_motion_is_respected: app.css has a prefers-reduced-motion block; test_focus_is_visible: it has a :focus-visible rule.

features.description: Every run page shows the campaign and digest in the context bar, and the verdict is its largest text.
steps: test_every_run_page_shows_campaign_and_digest: for each run route, the HTML contains the run's campaign and input_digest[:12].

test_the_panel_states_tasks_run_at_most_once.
test_an_unreachable_queue_is_reported_and_the_page_still_loads.

features.description: Studies imported by module path show their DAG and per-cell state.
steps: Create a small study module under tests/bench/ for the fixture.
test_dag_rows_are_in_order (compare the `order` field), test_cells_report_cached_or_to_run, test_an_unimportable_study_path_is_404_naming_it.

features.description: Opening a structure reports hashes, origin and every dropped HETATM.

test_a_local_pdb_reports_its_sha256 (64 hex chars, matching hashlib on the prepared file).
test_what_was_dropped_is_listed: the HOH residue name appears.
test_network_source_without_permission_is_400; test_a_missing_file_is_400_naming_it.

test_the_palette_groups_methods_by_rung (keys come from catalog.RUNGS).
test_an_unwired_tier_is_listed_with_a_reason_but_not_addable (qmmm).

features.description: The palette groups comparable methods by quantity and never presents one rigour ladder across quantities.
steps: test_methods_are_grouped_by_quantity: designability and field_dft_interaction are never in the same ordered group.
Data source: Method.comparable_rigour from smeltery.gui.catalog.

features.description: The site endpoint applies place_site and the returned TOML round-trips clean.

test_the_returned_toml_checks_clean: POST it back to /api/pipeline/check; no errors.

features.description: Launching stages inputs into OUT by hash and submits the documented argv.
steps: test_launch_stages_referenced_files_into_out: a pocket file outside OUT is copied in by sha256 and the written config's path knob points inside OUT.
test_launch_submits_the_documented_argv: the fake queue receives exactly ['smeltery','run','<OUT>/config.toml','--out','<OUT>'] and executes nothing.
Data source: OUT/config.toml as written, parsed with tomllib.

test_the_page_states_pose_pairing.
test_a_record_without_pose_output_is_409; test_an_out_of_range_pose_is_400.

test_no_composite_score_column.

features.description: Each honesty anchor in results-view.md is a test, and each is proven live by mutation.
steps: Tests: UNRANKED shows 'does not resolve' and never 'winner'; the floor and its source are on the page; INCOMPLETE renders as itself; tie groups carry labels as well as bands.
Mutation 1: render UNRANKED's first group as winner -> a test fails -> revert.
Mutation 2: drop the floor band -> a test fails -> revert.
Mutation 3: render INCOMPLETE as an empty verdict -> a test fails -> revert.
Mutation 4: serve a resolved matrix with one extra True -> a test fails -> revert.
Record in NOTES.md that all four mutations failed their tests.

test_an_invalid_smiles_is_400; test_an_unknown_reason_is_400.

steps: test_an_entry_records_artefacts_by_sha256.
test_there_is_no_route_that_edits_an_entry (PUT and PATCH are 404/405).
test_a_correction_supersedes_and_the_old_entry_stays_readable.
test_the_author_comes_from_identity.
